description: Lead Assessor (VET and Skills) is responsible for Assessor development and undertaking assessment training sessions. The Lead Assessor has a key role in assuring the quality of the assessment tools and methodologies. The Lead Assessor (VET and Skills) should also be able to provide recommendations for continuous improvement in effectiveness of the assessment process
awardingBodyName: Management and Entrepreneurship and Professional Skills Council
typeOfQualification: Cross Sectoral (CS), For ToT, For ToA

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Apply principles of professional practice at the workplace
Apply health and safety practices at the workplace
Mobilize assessors and support in their recruitment and onboarding
Evaluate on- field assessment and provide suggestions for improving training effectiveness
Deliver competency based, instructor-led training sessions as per session plan

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.EDUCATIONCOMPLETED: Certified on any domain skill of NSQF Level 5 (Technical/Vocational Standards)
Any other additional experience /academic qualification as required by the domain awarding body
eligibilityCriteriaGrid.COMPLETEDSPECIALIZATION: academic qualification as required by the domain awarding body
